name: Object detection from imagery (vessels, vehicles, aircraft, buildings)
keywords: object detection ship vessel vehicle aircraft building satellite imagery detections count confidence ai model bounding box planet maxar chips very high resolution vhr optical port harbour class length width chip
user_questions: What is where now?;Count versus baseline?;What is new since the last image?;How confident is each detection?
layers_default_on: Detection points or boxes colored by class, opacity or outline by confidence;Scene footprint with date;Imagery at high zoom;AOI
layers_default_off: Count heatmap used at low zoom
symbology: Class color for fill; confidence as opacity or outline weight; cluster detections at low zoom instead of drawing boxes.
widgets: KPI tile: count per class;time-series chart: count over time per AOI;feature-table;review queue: confirm or reject detections;confidence slider: minimum confidence filter;scene card: scene date, sensor, cloud cover;detection-inspector;aoi-summary-card
temporal: Scene date picker;Compare two dates by swipe or toggle;Count time series
interactions: Draw or select an AOI;Confidence slider;Click a detection to zoom and open the image chip;Review and export;Class and size filter
alerts: Count above baseline plus k sigma;New class inside a restricted AOI
pitfalls: No confidence or scene date shown;Comparing scenes with different cloud cover or resolution;Boxes at low zoom (cluster them instead);No false-positive feedback
data_sources: Planet, Maxar, Sentinel-1/2, model outputs
examples: Planet Analytic Feeds https://docs.planet.com/data/analytic-feeds/; EO Browser https://apps.sentinel-hub.com/eo-browser/
glance_question: How many objects of each class are in my area on the latest image, and how many are confirmed?
glance_answer: [kpi-tile] count per class inside the selected AOI with the change versus the previous scene and a confirmed versus still-to-review split, e.g. 42 vessels · 30 confirmed · 12 to review, [scene-card] acquisition date and time, sensor, ground resolution in m and cloud percent of the scene those counts come from, class-coloured boxes on the imagery in the same colours as the KPI
trust: every count names the scene it comes from: sensor, acquisition time, ground resolution and per-scene cloud percent, and two scenes of different resolution or cloud cover are flagged before their counts are compared (E05) (T07);each detection shows model confidence as a number plus a channel separate from class colour, and the minimum confidence in force is printed next to the count (E08) (D08);length and width in the detection-inspector are measured from the image in whole metres and labelled estimated with a tolerance of about one pixel, in the same unit in inspector, table and size filter (B04) (B06);the per-class KPI equals the table rows under the same AOI, scene, class and confidence filters, with that scope written next to the total (B05);confirmed, rejected and unreviewed are distinct states with icon and label, and an export or shared count says whether it holds confirmed detections only (B09);class colours are identical in boxes, KPI, chart and legend (D06)
flow: open the AOI → latest scene with detections clustered at low zoom and boxes at high zoom, per-class KPI and scene card (S16);pick the previous scene in the scene list or swipe → counts and boxes switch and both halves carry their acquisition date (T02);click a box or a table row → map zooms to it and the detection-inspector shows the chip with box, class, confidence, length and width in m, date and sensor (D09);confirm, reject or reclassify in the inspector → item marked with undo, the to-review count drops and the next detection loads (B09);export confirmed detections → message names count and file, e.g. 30 vessels exported to CSV · Open (B08);close the inspector → same table scroll, filters, scene and map view as before (B07)

trust: AIS positions and satellite detections are separate marker shapes and colours, and the legend and popup say which source each marker is (A07);every dark detection states the AIS match gate: search radius in km, time tolerance in minutes and the offset to the nearest AIS position (E09);AIS reception and SAR pass coverage show per-source as-of times and a coverage footprint, so a vessel is never read as absent where nothing was observed (D02) (D10);an AIS gap shows start, end and duration in h with the note that gaps can be technical, and interpolated track segments are dashed and labelled estimated rather than reported (B06);the KPI counts equal the event list rows under the same zone, time window and type filters, with that scope written next to each count (B05);speed in kn and distance in nm in KPI, profile, popup and table (B04)
